Help Centre

Frequently asked questions

How do I place an order?

Add items to your cart, review the items and shipping method, then choose “Place Order”. You will pay cash on delivery (COD).

Which payment methods are supported?

Currently only Cash on Delivery (COD). Online payment is not available yet.

How much is shipping?

Standard delivery is free when a seller order's subtotal is ₱2,000 or more, otherwise a flat fee applies. Pickup is free.

How do I become a seller?

Open “Become a Seller”, fill in your store details and submit. The KameraPH team reviews applications and notifies you of the result.

How do I cancel an order?

Go to My Purchases and open the order. You can cancel while it is Pending or Confirmed.

How do refunds work?

Refunds are handled by the KameraPH admin team after delivery and payment. Contact support with your order number.
